findings.evidence: "On a failure, fix the cause or re-delegate with the failing output, then rerun the same gates" restates the standard fix-and-rerun procedure. The useful additions are the retry limit and incomplete-work outcome.
findings.fix: Fold the three-attempt limit, failing-output handoff and incomplete-on-exhaustion outcome into the Verify step, removing the separate narration of the generic fix-and-rerun cycle while preserving the validation loop.
